subtitle.en: Track the qualified public evidence on how major AI infrastructure projects are built and powered. Ownership and financing details remain outside this projection until separately qualified.
subtitle.zh: 追踪主要 AI 基础设施项目建设与电力支持的合格公开证据。持有与融资细节在独立完成公开资格核验前不进入本投影。

summary.en: AI infrastructure can use corporate investment, joint ventures, project financing and long-term leases. These are distinct structures; this projection does not yet qualify project-specific financing badges.
summary.zh: AI 基础设施可采用公司投资、合资、项目融资及长期租赁等不同结构。本投影尚未核准项目专属融资标签。

boundaries.en: What this data can and cannot show
boundaries.zh: 数据能与不能说明什么

doubleCount.en: Project cost, corporate CapEx, project debt, lease commitments, guarantees, and maximum exposure may describe different layers of the same infrastructure. They should not be added together unless their scopes and asset identities are proven to be non-overlapping.
doubleCount.zh: 项目成本、公司资本支出、项目债务、租赁承诺、担保以及最大风险敞口，可能描述同一基础设施的不同层次。除非能够确认其范围和资产身份互不重叠，否则不应直接相加。

comparability.en: Native project definition; not directly comparable across all projects.
comparability.zh: 采用项目原始定义，并非所有项目之间都可直接比较。

missingness.en: Financing, ownership, lease and power disclosures differ across projects. Missing or unqualified information is not estimated.
missingness.zh: 不同项目的融资、持有、租赁和电力披露存在差异。缺失或尚未核验的信息不进行估计。

statusVintage.en: Status is a dated eligible disclosure, not a synchronized assessment of present full-campus operations.
statusVintage.zh: 状态反映带日期的合格披露，并非对所有园区当前完整运营情况的同步评估。

fairwater.en: Public completion timelines have changed across official disclosures. The dated construction status shown here does not resolve later milestone differences.
fairwater.zh: 官方披露的公开完工时间表曾有变化。此处带日期的施工状态不解决后续里程碑差异。

polaris.en: Comparison project outside the five-company coverage universe. It is not assigned to Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta or Oracle; contracted capacity is separate from reported live capacity.
polaris.zh: 该对照项目不计入五家公司覆盖，也不归入 Microsoft、Alphabet、Amazon、Meta 或 Oracle。合同容量与已报告上线容量分别展示。

utility.en: Utility generation and grid plans are separate from campus capacity and investment. Plans and options are not operational supply.
utility.zh: 公用事业发电与电网计划独立于园区容量和投资。计划及选项不等于已运营供电能力。

financing.en: No project-specific financing amounts, ownership percentages, lease terms or support amounts are included in this projection. Unknown does not mean absent.
financing.zh: 本投影不包含项目专属融资金额、持有比例、租赁条款或支持金额。未知不表示不存在。

guarantee.en: Conditional contractual support is not debt, expected loss or expected payment.
guarantee.zh: 附条件的合同支持不等于债务、预期损失或预期付款。

maximumExposure.en: Maximum exposure is not debt, expected loss or expected payment. No maximum-exposure headline is published.
maximumExposure.zh: 最大风险敞口不等于债务、预期损失或预期付款。本投影不发布最大敞口标题数字。

returns.en: Project-specific AI revenue and attributable cash flows are not identified here. AI economic return is not identified.
returns.zh: 本投影未识别项目专属 AI 收入及可归属现金流，AI 经济回报亦未识别。

counts.en: Project counts describe this curated projection, not economic size or a comprehensive infrastructure census.
counts.zh: 项目数量仅描述本精选投影，不代表经济规模或完整基础设施普查。

clock.en: The as-of date identifies the research knowledge boundary. Observation, source publication and source-vintage availability dates remain separate.
clock.zh: 截至日期表示研究知识边界。观察日期、来源发布日期和来源版本可用日期分别保留。

UNKNOWN.zh: 结构尚未完成公开资格核验
